title: Bumblebee holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 38 Q66 50 60 60' stroke='#e8e8e8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='25' rx='11' ry='14' fill='#ff5a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='25' rx='11' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a9a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='20' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ffb3b3'/>
  <polygon points='63,38 60,42 66,42' fill='#e04a4a'/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='48' rx='12' ry='7' fill='#cfe9ff' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-25 40 48)'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='44' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#cfe9ff' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-10 52 44)'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M40 76 L36 84' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 76 L52 84' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 76 L68 84' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='64' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M40 55 Q52 51 64 55' stroke='#2a2a2a' stroke-width='6' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M37 68 Q52 74 67 68' stroke='#2a2a2a' stroke-width='6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- little arm holding string -->
  <path d='M66 60 Q72 54 70 48' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='42' r='11' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M48 33 Q45 27 41 26' stroke='#2a2a2a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='25.5' r='2' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <path d='M56 33 Q59 27 63 26' stroke='#2a2a2a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='25.5' r='2' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='41' r='2.6' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='41' r='2.6' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='48.8' cy='40.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='40.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M48 46 Q52 49.5 56 46' stroke='#2a2a2a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
